functions.name: search-profiles
functions.description: Find professional profiles matching employment, education, location, skills, and contact-availability criteria. Return one page, optionally revealing contact details.

limit.description: Maximum profiles in this page; defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from an earlier result with identical filters, contact choices, and limit; omit for the first page.

filters.description: Optional matching criteria; omitted criteria do not restrict results. Boolean expressions are supported only in the documented text filters.

skills.description: Skill phrases or uppercase AND/OR/NOT expressions.

keyword.description: Phrase or uppercase AND/OR/NOT expression matched anywhere in the profile.

jobTitles.description: Job-title phrases or uppercase AND/OR/NOT expressions; use parentheses to group expressions.

proficiencies.description: Accepted provider proficiency labels; omit to accept any proficiency.

locations.description: Profile locations, such as cities or countries.

educations.description: Structured education criteria; each entry needs at least one field.

industries.description: Industry labels; prefix a label with uppercase NOT to exclude it. AND and OR are not supported here.

companyMatch.description: Match current employment, any past employment, past but not current employment, or either; omission uses current. Omit when matchExperience is set.

jobFunctions.description: Provider job-function labels, such as Engineering or Marketing.

pastCompanies.description: Companies in non-current roles; incompatible with companyMatch other than current and with same-experience matching when both titles and companies are set.

pastJobTitles.description: Titles held in non-current roles; cannot combine with currentTitlesOnly=false or same-experience matching when both titles and companies are set.

educationTerms.description: School or degree phrases, optionally using uppercase AND/OR/NOT expressions.

matchExperience.description: Require jobTitles and companies to match the same current, past, or either experience. Do not combine with currentTitlesOnly or companyMatch.

seniorityLevels.description: Provider seniority labels, such as Manager or Vice President.

currentlyWorking.description: True requires an active current role; false requires no active role; omission includes both.

companySizeRanges.description: Alternative inclusive employee-count ranges, serialized to provider range labels; accepted ranges depend on the provider taxonomy.

maximum.description: Inclusive upper bound in the same unit; must not be below minimum.

minimum.description: Inclusive lower bound, in years or employees as appropriate to the enclosing field.

currentTitlesOnly.description: True matches current titles only; false includes past titles. Omission uses the provider default, true; omit when matchExperience is set.

pastWorkLocations.description: Cities or countries of past work.

currentCompanyOnly.description: Provider's current-company-only restriction; omission uses true. Do not set inconsistently with companyMatch.

locationRadiusMiles.description: Radius in miles around the supplied city or area; requires locations.

recentlyChangedJobs.description: True requires a current job started within the last three calendar months; cannot combine with yearsInCurrentRoleRanges.

currentWorkLocations.description: Cities or countries of current work.

excludedCompanyMatch.description: Whether exclusions apply to current roles, past roles, or either; defaults to both when excludedCompanies is supplied.

includeRelatedJobTitles.description: Also match related job titles; omission uses false.

yearsOfExperienceRanges.description: Alternative inclusive total-experience ranges, measured in years.

maximum.description: Inclusive upper bound in the same unit; must not be below minimum.

minimum.description: Inclusive lower bound, in years or employees as appropriate to the enclosing field.

yearsInCurrentRoleRanges.description: Alternative inclusive years-in-current-role ranges; cannot combine with recentlyChangedJobs.

maximum.description: Inclusive upper bound in the same unit; must not be below minimum.

minimum.description: Inclusive lower bound, in years or employees as appropriate to the enclosing field.

contactTypes.description: Require availability of at least one selected contact type; this does not itself reveal contact details.

revealContacts.description: Reveal email addresses and phone numbers, incurring additional credits when found; false returns availability without revealing contacts.
